entries.summary: Migration 024 adds nullable password_hash on cms_pages and cms_posts. Admin/API set via content_password (min 6); leave blank to keep; remove_content_password clears. Duplicate copies the hash. Revisions snapshot the hash.

Published URLs remain 200. Body, layout, citation, TOC, comments, and blog excerpts stay hidden until POST /unlock/page|post/{id} (CSRF, session rate limit). Editors with edit_pages/edit_posts bypass. Unlock remembered in session and a 10-day HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie HMAC’d with cms_content_pass_key.
Public search, llms.txt, JSON content_text, OG/JSON-LD descriptions, RSS item descriptions, and featured-widget excerpts do not expose protected body text. API GET/list omit password_hash.

password_hash is in the SQL dump (hashed, never plaintext). cms_content_pass_key in app_settings restores unlock-cookie HMAC on the same site. Restore + pending migrations adds the column on older dumps.
